title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
Fry the pancetta until crisp.
Beat eggs and mix with Parmesan cheese.
Combine pasta, pancetta, and egg mixture.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spice mix for at least 1 hour.
Grill chicken pieces until cooked through.
Cook tomato puree with cream and spices to form sauce.
Add grilled chicken to sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve hot with rice or naan.

title: Avocado Toast
summary: Simple, healthy breakfast with smashed avocado on toasted bread — add toppings as you like.
ingredients: Toppings like eggs, tomatoes, or seeds
instructions: Toast the bread slices until golden brown.
Mash avocado in a bowl with salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
Spread avocado on toast and add your favorite toppings.
Serve immediately.

title: Beef Stir-Fry
summary: Quick and flavorful beef stir-fry with crisp vegetables and a soy-ginger sauce.
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (bell pepper, broccoli, carrot)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned.
Add vegetables and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes.
Pour soy sauce and ginger, and cook for another 2 minutes.
Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Vegan Buddha Bowl
summary: A nourishing bowl with grains, roasted veggies, greens and a tahini dressing.
ingredients: 1 cup roasted vegetables (sweet potato, broccoli, chickpeas)
instructions: Arrange grains as the base in a bowl.
Add roasted veggies and greens on top.
Drizzle with tahini dressing.
Serve fresh and enjoy.

title: Classic Pancakes
summary: Fluffy pancakes — perfect for weekend breakfasts. Top with butter, maple syrup or fruits.
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl.
Add egg, milk, and butter, then whisk until smooth.
Pour batter onto a hot griddle and cook until golden.
Flip and cook the other side.
Serve warm with toppings of your choice.
